updateTime.description: Timestamp of the last consolidation update of this datatake completeness document (UTC)

key.description: Unique identifier of the completeness document, derived from the datatake

name.description: Name of the datatake this completeness relates to

service_type.description: Type of the production service providing the products (partition field)

service_id.description: Identifier of the production service instance providing the products (partition field)

mission.description: Mission the datatake belongs to (e.g. S1, S2)

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit of the datatake (e.g. S1A, S2B)

datatake_id.description: Identifier of the datatake whose production completeness is measured

hex_datatake_id.description: Hexadecimal representation of the datatake identifier

application_date.description: Application date of the mission plan file that declared this datatake (UTC)

observation_time_start.description: Start of the datatake observation/sensing window (UTC)

observation_duration.description: Duration of the datatake observation window in microseconds

observation_time_stop.description: End of the datatake observation/sensing window (UTC)

l0_sensing_time_start.description: Start of the level-0 sensing window for this datatake (UTC)

l0_sensing_duration.description: Duration of the level-0 sensing window in microseconds

l0_sensing_time_stop.description: End of the level-0 sensing window for this datatake (UTC)

number_of_scenes.description: Number of scenes planned for the datatake (Sentinel-2)

number_of_expected_tiles.description: Number of tiles expected to be produced for the datatake

absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number of the datatake

relative_orbit.description: Relative orbit number of the datatake

instrument_mode.description: Instrument acquisition mode of the datatake

timeliness.description: Timeliness category of the expected products (e.g. NRT, NTC)

cams_tickets.description: CAMS anomaly ticket identifiers attached to this datatake completeness

datastrip_ids.description: Identifiers of the datastrips associated with this datatake

product_group_ids.description: Identifiers of the product groups associated with this datatake

last_attached_ticket.description: Identifier of the most recently attached CAMS anomaly ticket

last_attached_ticket_url.description: URL of the most recently attached CAMS anomaly ticket

cams_origin.description: Origin reported by the attached CAMS anomaly ticket(s)

cams_description.description: Description reported by the attached CAMS anomaly ticket(s)

name.description: Name of the missing period entry

product_type.description: Product type for which the sensing period is missing

sensing_start_date.description: Start of the missing sensing period (UTC)

sensing_end_date.description: End of the missing sensing period (UTC)

duration.description: Duration of the missing sensing period in microseconds

missing_periods.description: Sensing periods for which expected products are missing in the production
